name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; troops in Jakarta
summary: Thousands of troops deployed in Jakarta after generals' arrest; no G20 government collapse
state: Indonesia's military deployed thousands of troops in Jakarta after three senior police generals were arrested over alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo; officials describe it as a security measure (Jakarta Post, 5 Nov; AP via US News). No G20 government has fallen and no coup was reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Travellers to Jakarta should follow FCDO travel advice for Indonesia.
rubric_hit: No G20 collapse, contested election or coup = Normal

sources.title: Jakarta Post — Troops descend on Jakarta amid wiretapping scandal
US News — Indonesia deploys thousands of troops after generals arrested

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
